description:
For as long as I can remember I’ve wondered what it would be like to step out of the whole system. No 9 to 5, no landlord, no bills piling up. Just you, a van or a small cabin, figuring out the rest as you go.

I never fully did it myself, but I couldn’t stop reading about the people who did. Some chose it for freedom. A lot of them didn’t choose it at all. Rent went up, a job disappeared, and suddenly their car was their bedroom. Either way, they all had to figure out the same things. Where to sleep, how to stay warm below zero, how to eat, shower and keep their stuff safe.

That’s what this channel is about. I dig through news reports, forums and real stories, and turn them into videos that show how it really works. On the newer videos my sources are in the description.

Lived in your car, a van or a cabin? I’d love to hear your story. Send it through the “Share your story” link below, or drop it in the comments.

description:
Canadian native, Greg Ovens, has been studying outdoor survival and bushcraft since the age of 12. He spent the past 30 years living among the Canadian Rocky Mountains in the Columbia Valley of British Columbia, where he enjoys testing his hunting, fishing, hiking, and bush-crafting skills. Being a drywaller by trade, combined with his passion for outdoors, it’s no surprise that he also prides himself in being able to build a shelter out of just about anything.

Recently, Greg was on Season 3 of History Channel’s “Alone”, where he survived with no human contact for 51 days (over seven weeks) before hypothermia caught up with him in the Patagonian wilderness. He’s launching this channel with the video series, “30 Day Survival Challenge”, where he and Zachary Fowler (“Alone” Season 3 Winner) venture out into the Canadian Rockies of British Columbia, where the only rule is: if you want to eat, you have to catch and cook it.

Please contact Greg on email or Facebook Messenger.
